## About
Michael Grubbs started Grubbs Motorsports to build show cars and service classic cars. Along the way we took on a few collision jobs and found that show quality paint, perfect body lines and gaps made for collision repair our customers appreciated. That led to a full Collision Repair Center here on E. Buckingham in Garland.
We treat your car like it's our very own. We only fix what needs to be fixed, we use the highest quality materials, and we work for you, not the insurance company. If you have questions, go ahead and ask. We're here to listen.
Customers rate us 4.8 from 59 Google reviews.

## Services
- Complete Collision Repair: We inspect the car with you to identify the work and the type of paint needed to get the results you want.
- Paintless Dent Repair: When the paint isn't damaged, fixing a dent without repainting the panel can be more cost effective. Not all dents qualify.
- Aluminum Body Repair: Aluminum panels are heated, reformed and allowed to cool to hold their shape, using monitoring and specialized equipment.
- Frame Measuring & Straightening: Our frame machine uses hydraulics to pull a damaged frame back to factory specifications.
- Sheet Metal Repair & Replacement: Sometimes the best move is repairing a panel, not replacing it. We'll let you know what's involved in the straightening procedure.
- Chassis Replacement & Repair: Major and minor collisions can damage a vehicle's underlying structure. We'll tell you if repair can be done or if replacement is needed.
- Fleet Collision Repair: Collision repair for business trucks, vans and fleet vehicles, so they keep looking the way your brand should.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance agencies.

Q: What if the repair is self pay?
A: We offer free estimates for self pay accidents.

Q: Can any dent be fixed with paintless dent repair?
A: Not all of them. If there's paint damage we do conventional body work, and creased dents usually can't be done with PDR.

Q: Is the work warrantied?
A: Yes. We back our work with a written lifetime warranty.
